dogecoin.text:
Greg randomly called himself the “Fake CEO of Dogecoin.”
Dogecoin surged 10%.
Reddit ran wild.
Billy Markus joined in.
Someone even printed “Greg Coffee” with his face on the label.
A meme myth was born.
(4/9)

Greg joined Twitter in 2021 —
right in the middle of the GameStop and Dogecoin chaos.
His bio?
"im greg I like football and stocks and my birthday im from kentuckey."
(Yes, he misspelled Kentucky)
(3/9)

He took over Crypto Twitter without a token, team, or product.
Crowned “CEO” of Dogecoin for 24 hours.
No one really knows why.
But everyone knows his name.
Who is Greg?
(1/9)
